title: 2,4-Dichlorophenol Increases Primordial Germ Cell Numbers via ESR2a-Dependent Pathway in Zebrafish Larvae.
authors: Hu, Yan; Ma, Xuan; Liu, Rongjian; Mushtaq, Iqra; Qi, Yongmei; Yuan, Cong; Huang, Dejun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究2,4-DCP通过ESR2a信号通路增加斑马鱼原始生殖细胞数量，涉及分子对接和启动子报告实验，但核心是毒理学表型而非TF-DNA互作建模，方法以湿实验为主，AI/物理模拟深度不足。
abstract: Previous studies have reported the feminizing effects of 2,4-dichlorophenol (2,4-DCP) on zebrafish (Danio rerio). However, the effect of 2,4-DCP on the number of primordial germ cells (PGCs), an indicator for early sex differentiation, remains elusive. In the present study, Tg (piwil1:egfp-UTR nanos3) zebrafish (GFP-labeled PGCs) were treated with 2,4-DCP (10, 20, and 40 mug/L) from 5 to 15 days postfertilization to explore the effect on PGC numbers and to elucidate associated molecular mechanisms. The results showed that 2,4-DCP exposure increased PGC numbers, as evidenced by larger GFP fluorescent areas, upregulated expressions of PGC marker genes (vasa and dnd), and raised the female ratio. Notably, the mRNA level of estrogen receptor 2a (esr2a) was also increased subsequently. Moreover, docking studies revealed stable 2,4-DCP interactions with ESR2a, speculating a role of ESR2a signaling pathway in 2,4-DCP toxicity. Furthermore, in esr2a knockout (esr2a(-/-)) zebrafish, the effects of 2,4-DCP were considerably minimized, proving the involvement of the ESR2a signaling pathway in the 2,4-DCP-mediated increase in PGC numbers. Dual-luciferase reporter gene assay and point mutation studies demonstrated that 2,4-DCP-stimulated promoter activity was mediated by estrogen response element (ERE) located in -686/-674 of the vasa promoter and -731/-719 of the dnd promoter. Overall, 2,4-DCP can potentially enhance the expression of vasa and dnd by binding to zebrafish ESR2a, thus leading to increased PGC numbers and subsequent female-biased sex differentiation.
abstract_zh: 前期研究已报道2,4-二氯苯酚（2,4-DCP）对斑马鱼（Danio rerio）的雌性化效应。然而，2,4-DCP对原始生殖细胞（PGCs）数量（早期性别分化的指标）的影响仍不明确。本研究使用转基因（Tg (piwil1:egfp-UTR nanos3)）斑马鱼（GFP标记的PGCs），在受精后5至15天暴露于2,4-DCP（10、20和40 μg/L），以探讨其对PGC数量的影响并阐明相关分子机制。结果表明，2,4-DCP暴露增加了PGC数量，表现为GFP荧光区域增大、PGC标记基因（vasa和dnd）表达上调以及雌性比例升高。值得注意的是，雌激素受体2a（esr2a）的mRNA水平随后也升高。此外，分子对接研究显示2,4-DCP与ESR2a存在稳定相互作用，推测ESR2a信号通路在2,4-DCP毒性中发挥作用。进一步，在esr2a敲除（esr2a(-/-)）斑马鱼中，2,4-DCP的效应显著减弱，证明ESR2a信号通路参与了2,4-DCP介导的PGC数量增加。双荧光素酶报告基因实验和点突变研究表明，2,4-DCP刺激的启动子活性由位于vasa启动子-686/-674和dnd启动子-731/-719的雌激素反应元件（ERE）介导。总体而言，2,4-DCP可能通过结合斑马鱼ESR2a增强vasa和dnd的表达，从而导致PGC数量增加及随后的雌性偏向性别分化。
